Use case: stylized-concept
Deliverable: single isolated 3D asset reference for a stylized voxel mining game.
Subject: A thin flat rectangular walking deck made from six straight rough sawn oak planks fixed to two square cross battens underneath. Long horizontal rectangle, width four times depth, thickness tiny. Individual straight boards, dark narrow joints, saw marks, visible broad wood grain and square cut end grain. No railing, no legs.
Visual style: squared hand built timber construction, strongly rectangular silhouettes, chunky readable proportions, lightly chipped corners, broad coarse wood grain and visible iron fasteners. Minecraft-inspired tactile roughness but polished modern Roblox environment asset quality. Nothing inflated, puffy, glossy or overly rounded.
Materials: unpainted warm medium-brown rough oak, matte dark iron, weathered gray stone. Texture detail has chunky graphic strokes, not photorealistic noise. No yellow plastic, no blue trim.
Camera: three-quarter view, full object visible, centered with generous white margin.
Lighting: neutral soft diffuse studio light, minimal shadow, no baked harsh highlights.
Background: pure white, no floor plane or diorama plinth, no surrounding scene.
No text, no logos, no watermark, no characters.
